questions.subject: FILM_STUDIES
questions.learningObjective: Define and distinguish key film studies concepts
questions.stem: Which statement best defines Leitmotif?

options.text: It is a recurring musical idea tied to a particular character, place, or concept.
It is music placed beneath dialogue in order to heighten emotion subtly.
It is the assignment of musical lines to particular instruments within a score.
It is the transformation of a musical theme as a character or situation changes.

questions.explanation: It is a recurring musical idea tied to a particular character, place, or concept. This is precisely what Leitmotif means; the alternatives describe Underscoring, Orchestration, Motif development, which are different ideas.
questions.hint: Recall the specific meaning of Leitmotif.
